map.💡 工程总投资 = 建筑面积 × 各分项单价之和 + 不可预见费（按基数×费率）: 💡 Total investment = building area × sum of item unit prices + contingency fee (base × rate); unit cost = total investment ÷ building area.

map.算法：各分项造价 = 建筑面积×对应单价指标（土建/安装/装饰/配套/其他）；基: Algorithm: each item cost = building area × its unit price (civil / installation / decoration / facilities / other); base cost = sum of five; contingency = base × rate/100; total investment = base + contingency; unit cost = total investment / area (CNY/m²); total investment (10k CNY) = total / 10000; each item share = item cost / total × 100%.
